public.title: Bus Routes
public.description: Each route lists stops visited repeatedly by one bus in either direction of reachability: after boarding at any listed stop you can reach every other stop on that route. Return the minimum number of buses to board to travel from source to target, or -1 if impossible. Equal source and target needs zero buses. At most 100 routes with at most 1000 total distinct-per-route stops; stop identifiers are integers from 0 to 1000000.
hints: Expand all stops reachable with one additional boarding.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

javascript.signature: busRoutes(routes: number[][], source: number, target: number): number

typescript.signature: busRoutes(routes: number[][], source: number, target: number): number

explanation: Breadth-first levels count buses. Marking each route once bounds total route expansion by the input size. O(total listed stops) time and space.
